display_title: Are You Curious About the Review?
description:
Seo Gi-Un and Yeo U-Il started working together on a site specializing in adult products. In one of their recent reviews, there was a malicious comment that said: "The product reviews aren't made by a couple, so there is no credibility in them." 

Angrily, U-Il says, "Do I need to have a one-night stand to write a review?" To what Gi-Un replied without hesitation: "Let's do it". U-Il then panics, he is worried about whether their good relationship will take a blow after this, but it's a waste to leave a handsome face and body behind... 

*Note: The chapter count includes 5 special stories. *

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)**
